submission.justification: Mixture-G3 is recommended as it provides the best balance between environmental compliance and expected timing performance. While Mixture-G1 offers standard fluorinated mixture performance, it is eliminated due to its GWP100 of 1400, which far exceeds the laboratory's environmental policy limit of 150. Mixture-G2, with the lowest GWP100 of 15, represents the newest technology but may have uncertain timing performance with newer replacement gases. Mixture-G3, with a partial substitute for fluorinated components, maintains GWP100 at 120 (well within the 150 limit) while likely retaining timing characteristics closer to proven fluorinated mixtures. The 2.0 mm gap is selected as a standard configuration for RPCs that balances good time resolution with operational stability and manufacturing tolerances. This gap size is within the required 1-3 mm range and represents established practice for achieving sub-nanosecond timing in RPC detectors. Note: Without explicit simulation data in the available documents showing time resolution values for each mixture-gap combination, the achievement of the ≤1.5 ns requirement cannot be definitively confirmed and requires experimental validation.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md as one of the three available candidate mixtures.

requirements.requirement: The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better
requirements.evidence: No simulation data or measurement results for time resolution were found in the available project documents. Without explicit performance data, compliance with the 1.5 ns requirement cannot be confirmed, though Mixture-G3 with partial fluorinated components is expected to provide good timing performance based on RPC detector physics principles.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150
requirements.evidence: According to environmental_safety_review.md, Mixture-G3 has a GWP100 of 120, which is below the laboratory's environmental policy limit of 150.
The recommended gap of 2.0 mm falls within the specified range of 1-3 mm.
